ruleDefinitions.name: Azure Network Firewall Policy Modified or Deleted
ruleDefinitions.description: Identifies when a Firewall Policy is Modified or Deleted. Note: Unmapped fields: operationName

sequences.query: (operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/FIREWALLPOLICIES\/WRITE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/FIREWALLPOLICIES\/JOIN\/ACTION" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/FIREWALLPOLICIES\/CERTIFICATES\/ACTION" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/FIREWALLPOLICIES\/DELETE")
